executive_summary: Maven build failed with 22 compilation errors. The primary issue is that a custom Column class conflicts with JPA's @Column annotation, causing type conversion errors across multiple entity classes. Additionally, there are method signature mismatches and missing setter methods.

errors.message: incompatible types: Column cannot be converted to java.lang.annotation.Annotation (19 occurrences across Column.java, Task.java, User.java)
errors.root_cause: Custom Column entity class name conflicts with JPA @Column annotation. The compiler is confusing the custom Column class with javax.persistence.Column annotation, causing type conversion errors in all entity classes that use @Column annotations.
errors.fix_recommendation: Rename the custom Column entity class to a non-conflicting name such as 'BoardColumn', 'TaskColumn', or 'ColumnEntity'. Update all references to this class throughout the codebase including repositories, services, controllers, and tests.

errors.message: method getUserTasks cannot be applied to given types; required: Long,Pageable found: Long,int,int,String
errors.root_cause: TaskController is calling getUserTasks with 4 parameters (userId, page, size, sortBy) but the TaskService interface defines getUserTasks with only 2 parameters (Long userId, Pageable pageable). The controller is not constructing a Pageable object from the pagination parameters.
errors.fix_recommendation: In TaskController.getUserTasks method, create a Pageable object using PageRequest.of(page, size, Sort.by(sortBy)) and pass it to taskService.getUserTasks(userId, pageable) instead of passing individual pagination parameters.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: method setLastUpdated(LocalDateTime) (2 occurrences at lines 41 and 56)
errors.root_cause: The Column entity class does not have a setLastUpdated() method, but InMemoryColumnDataStore is attempting to call it to update the lastUpdated timestamp when columns are created or updated.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add a 'private LocalDateTime lastUpdated' field to the Column entity class along with its getter and setter methods. Alternatively, if using Lombok, add @Setter annotation to the class or specifically to the lastUpdated field.

errors.message: Build failed with 22 total compilation errors preventing compilation phase completion
errors.root_cause: The Column class naming conflict is the root cause that cascades into 19 type conversion errors across multiple entity files. Combined with the method signature mismatch and missing setter, the compilation phase cannot complete.
errors.fix_recommendation: Priority fix order: 1) Rename Column class to resolve 19 annotation conflicts, 2) Fix TaskController pagination to use Pageable, 3) Add setLastUpdated method to Column/renamed class. After these fixes, run 'mvn clean compile' to verify all compilation errors are resolved.
